document_selection: first 8 sorted previously confirmed full FDA PDF SHA-256s; technically reproducible, not randomized or nationally representative
limitations: Only first 40 pages would be inspected for PDFs longer than 40 pages; this run examined 46 pages in eight documents.
Nine pages had no extractable text and need visual/OCR review before any page-level adjudication.
A candidate application number appearing on a PDF page is not evidence of the action date, original review cycle, approval, or nonapproval.
The archived corpus of published FDA CRLs is not a complete NDA/BLA decision population.
